qa_pairs.question: What are the available storage areas on the Fir cluster, and what are their key features regarding access, quotas, and backups?
qa_pairs.answer: The Fir cluster offers 51PB of high-performance DDN Lustre storage, distributed among three main areas. The HOME area, accessed via `$HOME`, has a small, fixed per-user quota and features daily automatic backups. For larger storage needs, the PROJECT area, found at `$HOME/project/${def-project-id}`, provides large, adjustable per-project quotas with daily backups, ideal for group data sharing. Lastly, the SCRATCH area, accessible via `$HOME/scratch`, has a large per-user quota but no backup, and old files are automatically purged, making it suitable for temporary files. All mounts share the total available storage.

qa_pairs.question: What are the general specifications for the different types of compute nodes available on the Fir cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: The Fir cluster includes various compute nodes. There are 864 CPU nodes, each equipped with 192 cores, 750GB of available memory, 2 x AMD EPYC 9655 (Zen 5) @ 2.7 GHz processors, and 7.84TB NVMe storage. An additional 8 nodes also have 192 cores but feature 6000GB of memory, 2 x AMD EPYC 9654 (Zen 4) @ 2.4 GHz processors, and 7.84TB NVMe storage. For GPU-accelerated computing, there are 160 nodes, each with 48 cores, 1125GB of memory, 1 x AMD EPYC 9454 (Zen 4) @ 2.75 GHz processor, 7.84TB NVMe storage, and 4 x NVidia H100 SXM5 (80 GB memory) GPUs connected via NVLink.
